description: Share photos online as one link: a shared photo album with its own layout, pages and password. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

action.description: create (default) makes a new gallery from fileIds and returns its link. list returns the caller's live galleries with their tokens. edit changes one by token — only the fields you send change; send fileIds to replace the picture list in a new order. delete stops sharing one by token, and with deleteFiles also deletes its pictures.

captions.description: Captions matched to `fileIds` by position, so the third caption belongs to the third file. Use null or an empty string to leave one uncaptioned. Omit for none.

items.description: The caption for the file at the same position, or null for none.

columns.description: Pictures per row on a wide screen (default 3), treated as a maximum: a phone shows at most two across and a tablet three, whatever is set here.

deleteFiles.description: delete only: also delete the gallery's pictures from storage. A picture another live gallery still shows is kept. Omit to stop sharing and keep the files.

duration.description: How long the public link works, from now: 1h, 24h, 7d or 30d (default for create), and on Pro also 90d, 1y or never. For edit, omit to keep the current end. Always cut short if any of the files expires sooner.

fileIds.description: Required for create; for edit, the whole new picture list in order (omit to keep it). Ids of files the signed-in caller already owns, in the order they should appear. Upload first via POST /v1/files/upload-url then /v1/files/confirm; the gallery stores no bytes of its own. Up to 200 pictures; duplicates are shown once. The link never outlives the files it shows.

items.description: The id of a file in the caller's own storage, as returned on upload.

intro.description: The subtitle, shown as plain text under the heading; never rendered as a link. Omit for none.

layout.description: grid (default) crops every tile to a square for a uniform wall; masonry keeps each picture's own proportions and packs them.

password.description: A password visitors must enter before any picture is fetched. Omit, or send an empty string, for an open link.

removePassword.description: edit only: remove the gallery's password so the link opens without one.

rowsPerPage.description: Split the gallery into pages of this many rows (rows x columns pictures each), with Previous/Next buttons. Omit to show every picture on one page.

title.description: The heading shown at the top of the gallery page, up to 120 characters. Required for create.

token.description: The gallery's token, from list or from create's answer. Required for edit and delete.

name: photo_gallery
title: Share Photos
